title: chore(spec): prune 15 dead field display-config props (dead-surface plan, P2)
body:
First executed batch of the dead-surface disposition plan. Removes 15 FieldSchema enhanced-type **display** knobs with no runtime reader and no renderer consumer (dead in both layers per the field liveness audit): code theme/lineNumbers, rating allowHalf, location displayMap/allowGeocoding, address addressFormat, color colorFormat/allowAlpha/presetColors, slider showValue/marks, barcode/qr barcodeFormat/qrErrorCorrection/displayValue/allowScanning. Kept the wired knobs (language, maxRating, step) + functional nested configs (currencyConfig/vectorConfig/fileAttachmentConfig). Field types unchanged.

Verification: full @objectstack/spec suite green (242 files, 6562 tests); grep-confirmed no object/seed usage; ran the real app (objectstack dev showcase, 37 plugins) — boots clean, Console 200, 75 objects load, showcase_field_zoo exercises all 9 affected field types and parses+serves correctly (code field has language, no theme), no field errors in server log. Liveness gate green. (Headed-SPA screenshot not captured — no controllable Chrome in this env; pruned props have no renderer consumer.)

Note: confirmed pruning is a coupled refactor (schema → Field factory → tests → forms → translations; object props also hit NoExcessObjectKeys TS-strict defs) — remaining prunes proceed as small per-cluster verified PRs.
